parts:
Not sure what the question is but: 

1. Make sure you have Stan 2.11 not 2.10 installed, 2.10 had a bug in the sampler.
2. There were a few language changes ( "=" instead of "<-", etc...) but the old version still works so don't worry about it yet.
3. Sometime compiler warnings pop up but these look harmless.

It looks like your warnings are not important (so far) and the sampler is running so... it looks fine, good luck with the model!

Krzysztof
